Fraud investigation

Fraud Lens

I built a guided investigation that turns the messages, invoices and transfers from a fictional job scam into a report readers can check against the evidence.

Independent project

The problem

People often have screenshots, invoices and receipts in separate places. When the details are scattered, it is hard to build a clear account of what happened.

The decision

I made every finding in the case lead back to a message, document or payment. The report follows that timeline and stays editable so a reviewer can add context and correct the summary.

What you can try

Open the fictional case, compare two versions of the invoice and review three transfers to the same account. You can edit the final report and save it as a PDF. The case uses prepared chat findings.
